title: The Emerald Dress
shortLine: A rooftop escape. A hidden affair. A woman who should not be there.
synopsis: Jack’s quiet routines with his paralysed wife Julia conceal a private life of rooftop cigarettes and secret meetings with Ginny. The affair offers a brief escape from duty—until Jack discovers that the woman he has been seeing belongs to a past he cannot explain.
imageAlt: A woman in an elegant green-toned fashion portrait
detailLine: Some secrets survive longer than the people who keep them.
underneath: The supernatural twist is also a moral mirror: escape can feel harmless when the person being betrayed is kept out of sight. The uncanny arrives to expose what Jack has chosen not to see.
visualMotifs: A cigarette ember above the street
coreQuestion: If a secret gives you the life you think you deserve, what happens when it reveals the life you have actually been living?

detailImage.alt: A fashion portrait framed by shadow and city atmosphere
detailImage.caption: Desire is often photographed from its most flattering angle.

readerImages.alt: Carefully arranged garments and textured fabrics
readerImages.caption: A beautiful surface can conceal a life stitched with omissions.
